Northeast Animal Rescue is a regional non-profit organization located in China. Our commitments are rescue street animals, support sterilization and develop animal protection education. 

Although our current capabilities are limited, we can only give priority to helping the young, sick and in danger. But we believe that with the help of passionate supporters, our organization will continue to grow and will save more stray animals. Our goal is to promote the animal rescue work of the whole society through our continuous efforts, and finally establish a national animal rescue system.

Our work depends on donations from enthusiastic people. Please support us to save more poor animals.
